_source_note: Fully rebuilt (3rd pass, Sept 2026) from 36 real in-game tooltip screenshots pulled directly from Ascension by Kyle (StormmBringer.docx). This pass corrected several levels that earlier passes had wrong (Call of the Storm 4 not 6, Call of the Wind 14 not 6, Invigorating Surge 6 not 4, Razorwind 40 not 22) and added several class-wide abilities that were missing entirely: Stormbreaker, the 3-buff Aegis family (Whirlwind/Shocking/Tempest, mutually exclusive - one can be active at a time), and the 4-spell Pressure family (Barometric/Crushing/Atmospheric/Stabilizing, also mutually exclusive). IMPORTANT spec-lock correction: Aeroblast and Torrential Wrath are confirmed LIGHTNING-locked via their own 'Requires: ... Lightning (1)' tags, NOT Wind/Maelstrom as earlier passes assumed from name-vibes alone - ability names in this game do not reliably predict which spec they're locked to, the 'Requires' tag is the only trustworthy source.

abilities.name: Attack
abilities.description: A basic staff strike.

abilities.name: Shock
abilities.description: Shock an enemy with raw current, dealing Nature damage plus a lingering 1-turn DoT worth 10% of the hit.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 18 Mana, 35yd, 1.5s cast, Generates 20 Static, '17 Nature damage, plus an additional 20% of the initial damage over 1 sec.' Lvl 1. Extended to 8 ranks (was 5) per Kyle: starting abilities rank up much further, up to Rank 8-10, matching the treatment given to Venomancer's Venom Bolt/Serpent's Fang.

abilities.name: Discharge
abilities.description: Discharge electricity, restoring mana and dealing Nature damage to enemies in a small area around you.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 2 (was Lvl 4), Depletes 20 Static, 'restoring 15% of your maximum mana and dealing 18 Nature damage to enemies in a small area around you.' Extended to 8 ranks (was 5) - third core Static piece, matching Shock's rank tail.

abilities.name: Call of the Storm
abilities.description: Call upon the power of the storm to empower an allied player, increasing their Intellect. Does not stack with Call of the Wind.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 4 (was Lvl 6), 'increasing their Intellect by 3 for 30 min.'

abilities.name: Electrocute
abilities.description: Electrocute an enemy with a surge of raw current. Only usable against targets below 35% health.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 4 (was Lvl 10), Generates 20 Static, '25 Nature damage,' 'Only usable on enemies below 35% health.' Extended to 8 ranks (was 5) - core Static payoff, matching Shock's rank tail.

abilities.name: Conjure Storm
abilities.description: Conjure a storm over a target area, instantly dealing Nature damage plus additional damage over time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 8, Depletes 50 Static, '25 initial Nature damage. Deals an additional 102 Nature damage to enemies in the area over 12 sec.'

abilities.name: Invigorating Surge
abilities.description: Shock an ally's body, revitalizing it and instantly healing them.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 6 (was Lvl 4), Depletes 25 Static, 'instantly healing them for 76.' Extended to 8 ranks (was 5) - core Static payoff (heal), matching Shock's rank tail.

abilities.name: Whirlwind Aegis
abilities.description: Increases your Armor and spell haste. Lasts 30 min. Only 1 Aegis can be up at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 4, 'Increases your Armor by 60 and increases your spell haste by 3%.' Part of the mutually-exclusive Aegis family (Whirlwind/Shocking/Tempest) - implemented via exclusive_group like Tinker's Rounds.

abilities.name: Barometric Pressure
abilities.description: Thicken the air around you, slowing the movement speed of enemies and reducing their casting speed. Only 1 Pressure spell can be active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 12, 'slowing the movement speed of enemies by 20% and reducing their casting speed by 20%.' Part of the mutually-exclusive Pressure family (Barometric/Crushing/Atmospheric/Stabilizing).

abilities.name: Call of the Wind
abilities.description: Call upon the power of the wind to empower an allied player, restoring mana over time. Does not stack with Call of the Storm.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 14 (was Lvl 6), 'restoring 10 mana every 5 seconds for 30 min.'

abilities.name: Gust of Wind
abilities.description: Send forth a gust of wind in a frontal cone, knocking enemies back and interrupting their current spell cast.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 16, 'knocking enemies back and interrupting all enemies current spell cast, preventing any spell from that school from being cast for 5 sec.' Knockback translated to N/A in turn-based (no positioning system); interrupt+silence kept as the real mechanical payoff.

abilities.name: Storm Alert
abilities.description: Disturb an enemy with a vision of the coming storm, stunning them.
abilities._source: Kept from earlier pass (not re-confirmed or contradicted by this screenshot batch) - real-time fear translated to turn-based stun per project convention.

abilities.name: Crushing Pressure
abilities.description: Embolden the air around you, increasing the duration of movement impairing and fear effects on enemies. Only 1 Pressure spell can be active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 18, 'increasing the duration of movement impairing, fear, and horrify effects on enemies by 20%.'

abilities.name: Static Lock

abilities._source: Kept from earlier pass (not re-confirmed or contradicted by this screenshot batch).

abilities.name: Stormbreaker

abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 20, '3 Charges, 12 sec recharge.' Charge system compressed to a shorter flat cooldown to fit this game's turn-based combat length.

abilities.name: Shocking Aegis
abilities.description: Increases your chance to critically strike and reduces your chance to be critically struck. Lasts 30 min. Only 1 Aegis can be up at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 26, exact numbers verbatim. Part of the mutually-exclusive Aegis family.

abilities.name: Atmospheric Pressure
abilities.description: Destabilize the air around you, increasing the chance for enemies to be struck by spells and causing you to generate additional Static on damage taken. Only 1 Pressure spell can be active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 22, exact numbers verbatim.

abilities.name: Stabilizing Pressure
abilities.description: Stabilize the air around you, causing all raid and party members to lose less casting or channeling time when damaged. Only 1 Pressure spell can be active at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 30, exact numbers verbatim.

abilities.name: Razorwind
abilities.description: Destroys any damage absorption effects and damage immunity effects on an enemy.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 40 (was Lvl 22), exact mechanic verbatim.

abilities.name: Tempest Aegis
abilities.description: Increases your spell power based on your Intellect and increases your Nature and Frost Resistance. Lasts 30 min. Only 1 Aegis can be up at a time.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 44, 'increases your spell power by 10% of your Intellect and increases your Nature and Frost Resistance by 23.' Part of the mutually-exclusive Aegis family.

abilities.name: Freewind
abilities.description: A line of wind and lightning tears through all enemies.
abilities._source: Kept from earlier pass (not re-confirmed or contradicted by this screenshot batch).
abilities._design_note: A line of wind and lightning tears through all enemies. Assigned Nature school matching the Lightning tree's confirmed pattern (Forked Lightning, Aeroblast, Arm of Thorim all confirmed Nature per screenshot) - this ability's own school wasn't re-confirmed in the most recent screenshot batch, so this is the best-match assignment, not a directly confirmed one like its Lightning-tree siblings.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: Charge your body with electricity, generating a surge of Static and gaining brief haste.
abilities._source: Kept from earlier pass (not re-confirmed or contradicted by this screenshot batch).

abilities.name: Arm of Thorim
abilities.description: Call down a terrible beam of lightning upon an enemy, dealing Nature damage and stunning them.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lightning-locked, Requires Lvl 16 (Rank 2 shown), Depletes ALL Static, '167 Nature damage and stunning them for 1 sec. Damage and cast time increased based on Static level.' Rank 1 numbers extrapolated downward from the Rank 2 figure shown.

abilities.name: Forked Lightning
abilities.description: Shoot lightning at an enemy, bouncing to nearby enemies.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lightning-locked, Requires Lvl 22 (Rank 2 shown), 'dealing 142 Nature damage, bouncing to up to 4 enemies. Generates 5 Static for each enemy struck.' Fixed during DPS niche audit (Oct 2026): was plain enemy_aoe, hitting every living enemy in the fight rather than the tooltip's real 'up to 4 enemies' cap - added max_targets=4 (see combat/abilities.py's Ability.max_targets/_hostile_recipients). NOTE left unfixed/deferred: 'Generates 5 Static for each enemy struck' is a true per-target scaling that this ability does not currently have - generates (see Ability._generate_resource) fires once per CAST, flat, before targets are even resolved, so this grants a flat 5 Static regardless of how many of the up to 4 enemies were actually hit. Fixing that needs generates to scale with the real resolved-target count at _apply_effect time, a structural change to how `generates` works for every ability using it, not a one-line fix bundled here - flagged in claude/dps_niche_audit.md for a deliberate follow-up pass rather than built silently.

abilities.name: Volt
abilities.description: Fuse lightning into an enemy, dealing Nature damage over time and slowing them.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lightning-locked, Requires Lvl 22 (Rank 2 shown), '258 Nature damage over 18 sec and slowing them by 40%. Generates 2 Static per tick.' 18-second real-time DoT compressed to a 3-turn DoT for this engine.

abilities.name: Aeroblast
abilities.description: Crush an enemy with the weight of the winds, dealing Nature damage now and additional damage shortly after.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lightning-locked (despite the wind-sounding name), Requires Lvl 20, Depletes 50 Static, '207 Nature damage to them and then an additional time for 40% of the damage dealt after 1 sec.'

abilities.name: Call of the Lightning
abilities.description: Call upon the power of storms to empower an allied player, increasing their resistances.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lightning-locked, Requires Lvl 50, 'increasing their resistances by 20 for 30 min.'

abilities.name: Stormflow
abilities.description: Channel a storm beam upon an enemy. Shock can be instantly cast while channeling.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Maelstrom-locked, Requires Lvl 20, Depletes 20 Static, '152 Frost Damage over 8 sec, scaling with your spell haste. Shock can be instantly cast while channeling.'

abilities.name: Drown
abilities.description: Attempt to drown an enemy, reducing their healing received, then unleash a creature from the depths.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: Maelstrom-locked, Requires Lvl 24, 31 Mana, 'reducing their healing received by 20% for 8 sec. At the end of the duration, unleash a creature from the depths dealing 147 Frost Damage. Each stack of Conductive increases this effect's damage, stacking up to 8 times.'

abilities.name: Summon: Air Elemental
abilities.description: Call an Air Elemental to aid you in combat, replacing any pet you currently have.
abilities._source: Built during the pet-system push (Oct 2026, Kyle: 'We need the pet system up and running... since we have hunters, warlocks, primalist, and wind spec stormbringer'). Previously stubbed as a self-buff placeholder. Real pet template added (combat/pet_templates.py's 'air_elemental', pet_type 'stormbringer' - a caster-style ranged pet, Nature-damage Lightning Bolt). Talent-gated via Tempest's Call's unlock_ability (requires_talent below), same as the talent's own tooltip ('Learn Summon: Air Elemental'). NOTE: Lexicon of Servitude (tier 5, 'Increases your Air Elemental's damage by 6% per rank') reads a pet_damage stat_mod key not currently read anywhere in the engine - flagged on the pet template's own _source rather than silently left broken; wiring real pet-damage talent scaling is a separate, bigger mechanic than this one summon ability.

abilities.name: Raging Zephyr
abilities.description: A gust of wind that reduces an enemy's accuracy.
abilities._source: Wind-locked, level/numbers not yet confirmed via screenshot - placeholder values, flag for correction once Wind spec's own screenshots are reviewed.

abilities.name: Torrential Wrath
abilities.description: Blast an enemy, triggering Conduction and dealing Frost damage, scaling with your haste rating.
abilities._source: Confirmed screenshot: 'Lightning (1)' tagged per its own Requires line (an earlier pass had this as Maelstrom-locked and it's staying there structurally per Kyle's 'skip the move' call - ability defined here regardless of which tree currently unlocks it). 35yd, 2.5s cast, Depletes 40 Static, '213 Frost damage, scaling with your haste rating,' plus Conduction: '11 Frost Damage, increased for each stack of Conductive.'

abilities.name: Deluge
abilities.description: A wave of frost and water that damages and slows all nearby enemies.
abilities._source: Maelstrom-locked, level/numbers not yet confirmed via this screenshot batch (earlier pass had Lvl 27) - kept prior estimate, flag for correction once available.

abilities.name: Storm Ascendance
abilities.description: For a short time, your spell critical strikes have a chance to reset Electrocute's cooldown and grant Static.
abilities._source: Lightning capstone passive - the talent node ITSELF carries the mechanic text ('25% chance to reset Electrocute and grant 20 Static'), this ability entry exists mainly so unlock_ability has something real to point to. Since it's a passive proc rather than a cast player chooses to use, is_instant should probably be true and it may not need its own hotbar slot at all - flag for review once the proc-trigger pattern (like Rot Lich, Acidfang) gets a real shared implementation.
